pregen.commands.claim_corrupt: The stored sheet for “{name}” is unreadable — ask the Keeper to re-import the module card.
pregen.commands.claim_name_conflict: The name “{name}” already belongs to a character another player created — ask the Keeper to rename or remove that sheet first.
pregen.commands.claim_taken: “{name}” is already claimed by another player.
pregen.commands.claimed: You now play “{name}” ({system}) — the sheet is saved under you and set active.
pregen.commands.empty: No pre-generated characters yet — the Keeper adds them by importing module cards with `.import <file> world`, or creates one with `.pc gen [reference]`.
pregen.commands.gen_usage: Usage: .pc gen [reference] — the AI writes the character's name and description from the module's summary; the sheet uses the room's active system.
pregen.commands.gen_no_module: ❌ This room has no initialized adventure to fit a character to — import or initialize a module first, then .pc gen.
pregen.commands.gen_no_name: ❌ The AI could not name the character — try again, or give a reference hint (e.g. .pc gen 阿岚 | 瘴雾镇的调查员).
pregen.commands.gen_done: ✅ Added “{name}” ({system}) to the roster — claimable by players (.pc claim) and the AI (.party add).
pregen.commands.gen_failed: ❌ Could not add “{name}” to the roster (no usable name or the roster is full).
pregen.commands.help: The room's pre-generated character roster: .pc [list] | .pc gen [system] <name> | <description> | .pc claim <name> | .pc release [name] — module imports and .pc gen fill it; players claim their PC from it and the AI claims companions from it.
pregen.commands.reclaimed: “{name}” ({system}) is already yours — set active again.
pregen.commands.release_not_yours: Only the claiming player (or the Keeper) can release “{name}”.
pregen.commands.released: Released “{name}” — it is claimable again (the played copy was discarded; the next claimant starts fresh).
pregen.commands.info_usage: `.pc info <name>` — show a character's dossier (module source, memory, relationships)
pregen.commands.delete_module_denied: ❌ “{name}” is a module-imported cast member — only room-born (.pc gen) characters can be deleted.
pregen.commands.delete_claimed: ❌ “{name}” is claimed — release it first, then delete.
pregen.commands.gen_pending: Generating a roster character from the module…
